concept: FDE Portfolio Capstone: Northstar Support Operations
title: Northstar FDE Portfolio Lab
briefing: Build the 16–23 hour synthetic Northstar capstone in several sessions using the companion contract. The 1200-minute estimate is a planning midpoint. Use a local database and fake adapters; a paid model is optional. The app does not run or grade the repository, audit security or verify real customer outcomes.
objectives: Deliver one complete authorized customer workflow.
Prove failure behavior with reproducible fixtures and evaluations.
Provide a demo, operational handover and honest impact memo.

prediction.prompt: Where do you expect the largest delivery uncertainty?

steps.title: Create the brief and fixture manifest
steps.instructions: Use two tenants, ten orders and twenty tickets per tenant plus twelve policy documents. Include cross-tenant repeated IDs, missing records, stale data, duplicates and contradictions. Record expected outcomes before implementation.

steps.title: Build one complete workflow
steps.instructions: Implement authorized lookup, source timestamps, draft review and local save. Add permission and receipt tests before the implementation. Handle denied, empty, stale and unavailable states explicitly.

steps.title: Run failure and evaluation cases
steps.instructions: Use the lesson's acceptance matrix and forty-case evaluation. Keep development and held-out cases separate. Inject response loss, duplicate events and a revoked user. Record per-case outcomes and versions.

steps.title: Package and recover
steps.instructions: Create a disposable local artifact, verify startup with inert dependencies, and run an outage/recovery exercise. Write deployment, rollback, ownership and escalation instructions.

steps.title: Demo and transfer ownership
steps.instructions: Record a five-minute demo with normal and failure flows. Ask a peer to use the runbook. Write an impact memo separating assumptions, synthetic measurements and any real peer feedback.

reflectionPrompts: Which requirement changed and how did you negotiate it?
What evidence would be required before a real customer deployment?
Could another maintainer recover the application without you?
extensionChallenge: Add a second fictional customer with different policy and a tighter freshness requirement. Generalize only the shared invariant and document what remains customer-specific.

evidenceChecklist.label: I saved the brief, fixture manifest and baseline.
I demonstrated tenant isolation and explicit failure states.
I recorded evaluation results including failed cases.
I verified local artifact startup and a recovery drill.
I produced a demo, runbook and evidence-labeled impact memo.
